summary: Remove the invoke handler for a channel.

target.notes: Remove only the invoke handler for the channel, not unrelated EventEmitter listeners.

caveats: ipcMain.on listeners are a different registration mechanism and must not be removed by removeHandler.
references: Electron IPC tutorial / Structured Clone semantics

tests.name: remove existing handler
tests.expected_behavior: future invoke calls no longer use fn

tests.name: channel event listener remains
tests.expected_behavior: the ordinary ipcMain.on listener remains registered
